findings: The exercise is explicitly fictional and tests textual interpretation, not live fire or evacuation advice.
Provisional concerns revision status; approximate concerns positional precision; resolution concerns sensor detail. The passage defines these separately.
Obscured ground and sub-resolution gaps are distinguished from confirmed absence; uncertainty shading is not labelled extra fire.
Corroborate applies to independent agreement, reconcile to conflicting accounts, and retrospective review cannot assume later evidence was available earlier.
Unused ceremonial, consent, dormant, obediently and surplus cannot complete the defined slots; the mapped fire boundary is not equated with an evacuation instruction.
